//backends: Which backend processes this electron app runs structure-lint for. Read by eslint.config.mjs at load; devkit migrate merge-preserves your values. Flip one off if you don't ship it.
//review: paths.include/exclude defines the shared reviewable repository universe for every reviewer; backendRoots/frontendRoots then route eligible files to domain reviewers. An EMPTY frontendRoots array means frontend-security-reviewer and frontend-performance-reviewer are never selected; an EMPTY backendRoots array similarly disables backend domain reviewers. Omit paths to preserve legacy reviewer selection. trustBoundaries, shortcutTracking, and accessibility configure reviewer context. prNotes (default true) lists PASS reviewers' non-blocking advisories under Reviewer notes in a devkit-shipped PR body; false leaves them out.

review.trustBoundaries: src/main = privileged Node process that ships inside the user-extractable app binary, so it holds no credentials or API keys; treat IPC arguments and sender, MCP/agent payloads and filesystem/network input reaching it as untrusted; src/renderer + src/preload = untrusted web context; src/shared = runs in both, validators of untrusted input live here; socket-server + vercel-serverless = trusted backend holding the secrets
